articles.title: Straumann (SWX:STMN) Stock Looks Below Fair Value On Cash Flow

articles.title: Straumann Group beats Q3 estimates, confirms 2026 outlook
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Straumann Holding AG (BS:STMNz) on Wednesday reported third-quarter revenue of CHF 667.1 million, representing 9.2% organic growth that exceeded analyst expectations of 8.6%, as the Swiss dental implant maker maintained momentum across most regions.

articles.title: GS adds four European stocks to conviction list as earnings catalysts emerge
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs added Solaria, Straumann, Scout24 and IMCD to its European Conviction List for October, while removing Naturgy, Norsk Hydro and Smith & Nephew, the broker said in a note dated Thursday.
